title: Electron-pair donor-acceptor relation
statement: A Lewis acid/base relation joins a distinct electron-pair donor and acceptor through the same two exclusion-preserving electron occurrences, with both identities retained.
generation_rule: Generate the literal product of the registered Lewis endpoints, support, donor, acceptor, joining, conservation, record and extension choices.
grammar_boundary: Every finite donor/acceptor pair joined by one exclusion-preserving pair of named electron occurrences, with both electron identities conserved and the donor/acceptor orientation retained.

choices.name: one-unoriented-species
choices.reason: The relation requires donor and acceptor roles.

choices.name: single-electron-only
choices.reason: The registered relation concerns paired support.

choices.name: two-electron-occurrences
choices.reason: Two distinct electron carriers form the pair.

choices.name: electron-pair-name-only
choices.reason: A name cannot demonstrate available support.

choices.name: pair-donor-support
choices.reason: The donor supplies access to both retained occurrences.

choices.name: unregistered-vacancy
choices.reason: An unregistered destination cannot close the interaction.

choices.name: pair-acceptor-support
choices.reason: The acceptor supplies an admitted receiving channel.

choices.name: shared-or-transferred-pair
choices.reason: The same pair supplies the joining support.

choices.name: Lewis-label-only
choices.reason: A label cannot reconstruct pair support.

choices.name: endpoint-pair-joining-trace
choices.reason: Endpoints, electron occurrences and joining remain held.

choices.name: free-orbital-premise
choices.reason: An imported orbital rule can select a desired classification.

choices.name: no-extra-rule
choices.reason: Complete donor/acceptor pair support supplies the class.

induction_base: Two named electron occurrences, one donor and one acceptor supply the first Lewis pair relation.
induction_step: Appending one independent donor/acceptor pair retains exclusion, both electron identities and every endpoint trace.
exclusions: no acid/base dictionary, pH scale, equilibrium equation, dissociation constant, measured value or V2 answer may select a candidate
no numerical zero, negative, irrational, imaginary or floating proof quantity
no free, fitted, learned or target-derived parameter
no unpaired creation, copying or loss of a proton or electron carrier
no claim that structural closure alone fixes every solution-dependent strength or capacity value
external target content remains inaccessible until the prediction is sealed
Every finite donor/acceptor pair joined by one exclusion-preserving pair of named electron occurrences, with both electron identities conserved and the donor/acceptor orientation retained.
operational_witnesses: the relation contains exactly two electron occurrences
the two electron occurrence identities are distinct

target_rows.source_locator: official IUPAC source set anchored at L03508

falsification_condition: The claim fails if the authoritative Lewis record lacks an electron-pair donor, electron-pair acceptor or conserved pair relation, or if a changed row is accepted.
